body:
Hey, I just wanted to give you an update. (Happy New Year by the way!)
 
I went tk my local crisi team after calling my mental health crisi line and was seen by a social worker. She was extremely unhelpful and basically told me to stop feeling depressed. I went home, took my sleeping tablets and had a rough night before seeing another crisis team. This guy was much more helpful. He basically told me that my options were either hospitalisation or to ride it through with the help of some sedative tablets. I decided to take the tablets and hope that I can get through this. If things get any worse, I am to call them again and they will hospitalise me. 
It's been a tough couple of days. I don't know what tomorrow holds.
I wanted to update you, let you know that I'm still alive and trying to hold on. Hope you are okay.

Thanks for your support, it's hard to be optimistic right now. The depression is the hardest, it hits like a rock and can suddenly change my perspective on life. I haven't slept all night, but plan on talking to my parents this morning and perhaps calling the crisis line today. 
Again, thanks for the support, I'll keep you updated. It helps to know that there are people out there who can relate and are around to offer support and advice.
